faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Everything Street.
faq.supportHours: Our support team is available Monday–Saturday, 9AM–6PM GET.

items.q: Where do you source your products?
items.a: We partner directly with official brand distributors and authorized retailers in the US, Europe, and Asia. Every brand on our platform has been vetted and approved.

items.q: What if I receive a damaged product?
items.a: Contact us within 7 days of delivery and we'll arrange a full replacement or refund immediately. We'll also cover return shipping costs for damaged items.
We offer 30-day hassle-free returns on all products. Items must be unused, in original packaging, with all tags attached. Beauty products must be unopened and sealed.

items.q: How long does a refund take?
items.a: Once we receive your returned item, refunds are processed within 3–5 business days and appear on your original payment method within 5–10 business days.

items.q: Are there any items that cannot be returned?
items.a: Opened beauty products (for hygiene reasons), personalized items, and digital downloads cannot be returned unless defective.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), and Cash on Delivery in select regions.

items.q: Can I combine multiple coupon codes?
items.a: Only one coupon code can be applied per order. However, coupons can be combined with sale prices.

items.q: How do I change my password?
items.a: Go to Account → Profile and use the 'Change Password' option. You can also use 'Forgot Password' on the login page to reset via email.

shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.subtitle: Fast, reliable delivery to your door.
shipping.processingContent:
Orders are processed within 1–2 business days after payment confirmation. Orders placed before 14:00 GET (Georgia Standard Time) on a business day are typically processed that same day.

Orders placed on Georgian public holidays (New Year's Day, Orthodox Christmas, Epiphany, Mother's Day, Independence Day, St. Mary's Day, Assumption Day, Svetitskhovloba, St. George's Day) are processed on the next business day.

You will receive an order confirmation email automatically after payment. A separate dispatch email with tracking information is sent once your order has been handed to the courier.
shipping.domesticContent:
Standard Shipping (2–5 business days): ₾15 — FREE on orders over ₾200
Express Shipping (1–2 business days): ₾25

Tbilisi orders: Standard delivery is typically 1–2 business days within the city. Express orders placed before 14:00 GET are usually delivered the following business day.

Regional orders: Delivery to regions outside Tbilisi may take the full 2–5 business days for standard shipping.

Shipping charges are displayed at checkout before you confirm payment.
shipping.internationalContent:
We ship to select countries across Europe, the Middle East, and beyond. Available destinations are shown at checkout.

Turkey & CIS countries (Azerbaijan, Armenia, Russia, Ukraine, etc.): 4–6 business days
Europe & UK: 7–10 business days
Middle East: 7–10 business days
North America & Asia: 10–14 business days

Delivery times are estimates and do not include customs clearance time, which varies by country and is outside our control. We cannot guarantee delivery dates for international orders.
shipping.dutiesContent:
International orders may be subject to import duties, taxes, and customs inspection fees charged by the destination country. These charges are entirely the responsibility of the recipient and are not included in our prices or shipping fees.

We are unable to predict or control customs charges or delays. If a package is refused at customs or abandoned by the recipient, we cannot issue a refund for the original shipping cost.

Some countries restrict the import of certain beauty ingredients or electronics. It is the buyer's responsibility to verify that the products ordered are legal to import in their country.
shipping.beautyRestrictionsContent:
Certain beauty products are subject to shipping restrictions due to their composition:

• Fragrances & perfumes: Contain flammable alcohol and are classified as hazardous for air transport. International shipments of fragrances are sent by ground or sea freight only, which may result in longer delivery times.

• Aerosol products (hairspray, dry shampoo, body spray): Cannot be shipped internationally by air. Ground shipping only for international destinations. Domestic delivery is not affected.

• Nail products containing acetone or strong solvents: Subject to the same flammable liquid restrictions as fragrances for international air shipments.

• Temperature-sensitive products (certain serums, treatments): We use protective packaging to maintain product integrity during transit. We are not liable for temperature damage caused by carrier mishandling or extreme weather conditions during shipping.
shipping.techRestrictionsContent:
• Lithium battery products: Devices containing lithium-ion or lithium-metal batteries (phones, tablets, laptops, wireless headphones, smartwatches) are subject to IATA air freight regulations. These regulations limit the number and capacity of batteries per shipment. We comply fully with these regulations. On rare occasions, a specific international route may not accept battery-containing devices — we will notify you if this applies to your order.

• Regional restrictions: Some electronics (smartphones, tablets, radio-frequency devices) may face additional import inspection or certification requirements in certain countries. Buyers are responsible for verifying import eligibility before ordering.

• Voltage compatibility: Products sold in Georgia are configured for 220V / 50Hz. International buyers should verify voltage compatibility before purchasing.
shipping.trackingContent:
Once your order is dispatched, you will receive a dispatch confirmation email containing your tracking number and a link to track your shipment.

You can also track your order at any time by logging into your account and visiting 'My Orders'.

Tracking updates may be delayed during customs processing, weekends, and public holidays. If your tracking has not updated for more than 5 business days, contact us at hello@everythingstreet.ge.
shipping.lostContent:
Lost packages: If your tracking shows no movement for more than 10 business days (domestic) or 20 business days (international) after dispatch, contact us at hello@everythingstreet.ge. We will open a claim with the courier and either reship your order or issue a full refund.

Damaged on arrival: If your package arrives damaged, do not discard the packaging. Take photographs of the outer packaging and the damaged item immediately. Contact us within 48 hours of delivery with photos. We will arrange a free replacement or full refund.

Failed delivery: If a delivery attempt fails, the courier will leave a notice. Most carriers make 1–2 additional attempts or hold the package at a local depot for collection. If the package is returned to us as undeliverable, we will contact you. A re-delivery fee may apply.

returns.title: Returns & Refunds
returns.subtitle: Your rights, clearly explained.
returns.overviewContent:
Under Georgia's Law on Consumer Rights Protection (Article 12), for purchases made online (distance contracts), you have the right to cancel your order and return goods within 14 calendar days of receiving them, without giving any reason. This is your statutory right and cannot be waived.

To exercise this right, notify us at returns@everythingstreet.ge within 14 days of receiving your order. You then have a further 14 days to return the goods to us.

We will refund your full payment — including the original standard shipping cost — within 14 days of receiving the returned goods, using your original payment method (Stripe).

Note: The 14-day return right is a minimum legal standard. Some product categories are subject to hygiene and software exceptions, as detailed in the sections below.
returns.beautyContent:
RETURNABLE:
• Sealed, unopened products in original undamaged packaging
• Products that arrived damaged, defective, or different from what you ordered
• Products where we sent you an incorrect item

NOT RETURNABLE (hygiene exception):
Under Georgian consumer law and EU Directive 2011/83/EU, cosmetic and beauty products that have been unsealed after delivery are exempt from the 14-day return right for hygiene reasons. The following cannot be returned once opened or unsealed:
• Skincare products (serums, creams, masks, treatments)
• Makeup (foundation, lipstick, mascara, eyeshadow)
• Haircare products (shampoo, conditioner, treatments)
• Body care products (lotions, scrubs, oils)
• Fragrances and perfumes where the seal or cellophane has been removed
• Nail products that have been opened

This hygiene exception is disclosed here and will be clearly noted at checkout before you confirm your purchase.
returns.techContent:
RETURNABLE:
• Unopened electronics in original sealed factory packaging within 14 days
• Defective or faulty products (see Damaged Items section)
• Wrong item received

NOT RETURNABLE:
• Software licence keys, digital downloads, or activation codes once revealed or activated — digital content is excluded from the right of return once accessed
• Products with physical damage caused by the customer after delivery
• Products with removed, altered, or defaced serial numbers

ELECTRONICS WARRANTY:
All electronics are covered by the mandatory 2-year legal guarantee under Georgian consumer law. If a product develops a defect within 6 months of purchase, the defect is presumed to have existed at the time of sale and we will repair, replace, or refund at no cost to you.

For defects arising between 6 months and 2 years, you may need to demonstrate the defect existed at purchase. Contact returns@everythingstreet.ge with your order number and a description of the fault.
returns.howToContent:
1. Email returns@everythingstreet.ge within 14 days of receiving your order
2. Include your order number, the item(s) you wish to return, and the reason
3. We will reply within 1–2 business days with return instructions and a return address
4. Pack the item securely in its original packaging and ship it to us
5. Once we receive and inspect the return, your refund will be processed within 14 days

Please keep proof of postage until your refund is confirmed. We are not responsible for items lost in return transit.
returns.refundContent:
Refunds are issued within 14 days of us receiving your returned goods (required by Georgian consumer law).

Refunds are credited to your original payment method via Stripe. Depending on your bank, the funds may take an additional 5–10 business days to appear on your statement after we process the refund.

We will refund the original standard shipping cost if the return is due to our error (wrong item, defective product, or damaged in transit). If you are returning due to a change of mind, the original shipping cost is non-refundable.
returns.shippingCostsContent:
• Defective, damaged, or wrong item: We cover the full cost of return shipping. We will provide a prepaid return label or arrange collection.

• Change of mind (eligible items only): You are responsible for the cost of return shipping. We recommend using a tracked service, as we cannot be responsible for items lost in transit.

• International returns: You are responsible for all return shipping costs, including any customs duties on the returned package. We cannot refund customs charges paid on the original shipment.
returns.damagedContent:
If your item arrives damaged or appears defective:

1. Do not discard the original packaging
2. Take clear photographs of the packaging and the damaged/defective item
3. Contact us at returns@everythingstreet.ge within 48 hours of delivery
4. Include your order number and attach your photos

We will assess your claim and arrange a free replacement, repair, or full refund within 5 business days of receiving your report.
returns.internationalContent:
The same 14-day return rights apply to all orders regardless of delivery country.

Return shipping: For international returns, you are responsible for all return shipping costs and any customs duties assessed on the returning package. We strongly recommend using a tracked and insured shipping method, as we cannot process refunds for items that are lost in return transit.

Customs on returns: Some countries charge import duty on returned goods. These charges are your responsibility. We cannot reimburse customs fees paid on either the original shipment or the return.

Once we receive your international return and verify its condition, we will issue your refund within 14 days using your original payment method.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Everything Street we take your privacy seriously. This policy explains what personal data we collect, why we collect it, how we use it, and your rights — in plain language.
privacy.s1Content:
Everything Street
Shalva Nutsubidze St, Tbilisi, Georgia
Email: legal@everythingstreet.ge
Phone: +995 500 09 06 14

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data when you use our website or place an order. It is governed primarily by Georgia's Law on Personal Data Protection (Law No. 5669, as amended) and, where applicable to customers in the European Economic Area or United Kingdom, by the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and UK GDPR.
privacy.s2Content:
a) Account & Order Data
When you create an account or place an order, we collect your name, email address, phone number, shipping address, and billing address.
Legal basis: Performance of contract (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)).

b) Payment Data
We do not store, see, or process your card number, CVV, or full payment details. All payment data is transmitted directly to Stripe Payments Europe Ltd.
See Stripe's Privacy Policy: stripe.com/privacy
Legal basis: Performance of contract; legal obligation.

c) Stripe Radar — Automated Fraud Screening
Stripe uses automated fraud detection technology that analyses transaction signals — including IP address, device fingerprint, and purchase patterns. If you believe a legitimate order was incorrectly declined, contact us at hello@everythingstreet.ge.
Legal basis: Legitimate interests — fraud prevention (GDPR Art. 6(1)(f)).

d) Device & Technical Data
When you visit our website, we automatically collect your IP address, browser type, operating system, pages visited, and referring URLs.
Legal basis: Legitimate interests (site security and operation).

e) Analytics Data
We use Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to collect anonymised usage statistics. GA4 cookies are only activated after you provide consent.
Legal basis: Consent (GDPR Art. 6(1)(a)).

f) Marketing Communications
If you subscribe to our newsletter, we store your email address and a record of your consent. You may unsubscribe at any time.
Legal basis: Consent (GDPR Art. 6(1)(a)).

g) Customer Support
If you contact us by email, we retain the content of those communications.
Legal basis: Legitimate interests.
privacy.s3Content:
We use your personal data to:
• Process and fulfil your orders, including arranging delivery
• Process payments securely via Stripe
• Detect and prevent fraud (Stripe Radar)
• Send order confirmation, dispatch, and delivery notifications
• Respond to customer service enquiries
• Send marketing emails (with your consent only)
• Analyse website usage and improve our services (with your consent)
• Comply with Georgian tax, accounting, and legal obligations
• Defend our legal rights if a dispute arises
privacy.s4Content:
We share your personal data only with service providers who require it to perform specific functions. We do not sell your personal data.

• Stripe Payments Europe Ltd — payment processing and fraud detection
  Location: United States and EU | Safeguard: Standard Contractual Clauses
  Policy: stripe.com/privacy

• Supabase Inc. — database and file storage
  Location: EU region (Frankfurt, Germany)

• Resend Inc. — transactional email delivery
  Location: United States | Safeguard: Standard Contractual Clauses

• Vercel Inc. — website hosting and edge delivery
  Location: US and globally distributed edge nodes | Safeguard: SCCs

• Google LLC (Google Analytics 4) — anonymised website analytics
  Location: United States | Safeguard: Standard Contractual Clauses
  Opt-out: tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout

• Upstash Inc. — rate limiting and abuse prevention
  Location: EU region

• Georgian tax authorities and regulatory bodies — where legally required
• Law enforcement or courts — only when legally compelled
privacy.s5Content:
Several of our service providers process data outside the EEA and Georgia:

• Stripe: United States — protected by EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs)
• Resend: United States — protected by EU Standard Contractual Clauses
• Vercel: United States and global edge — protected by EU Standard Contractual Clauses
• Google Analytics: United States — protected by SCCs and Google's Data Processing Terms

Copies of applicable SCCs are available on request from legal@everythingstreet.ge.
privacy.s6Content:
We retain your personal data for the following periods:

• Order records and transaction data: 7 years (required by Georgian tax and accounting law)
• Account profile data: for the duration of your account, plus 2 years after you close it
• Marketing consent records: until you withdraw consent, plus 3 years for audit purposes
• Customer support communications: 3 years from the last exchange
• Analytics data: 14 months
• Payment records: per Stripe's own retention policy

You may request earlier deletion of your data at any time.
privacy.s7Content:
Under Georgia's Law on Personal Data Protection and the GDPR (for EEA/UK residents), you have the following rights:

• Right to access — request a copy of all personal data we hold about you
• Right to rectification — ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete data
• Right to erasure — ask us to delete your personal data
• Right to restrict processing
• Right to data portability
• Right to object
• Rights related to automated decision-making — contact hello@everythingstreet.ge to request human review
• Right to withdraw consent — at any time

To exercise any of these rights, email legal@everythingstreet.ge. We will respond within 30 calendar days.
privacy.s8Content:
If you are not satisfied with how we handle your data, you have the right to lodge a complaint:

Georgia:
Personal Data Protection Service of Georgia
Website: pdp.ge | Email: info@pdp.ge

European Union / EEA residents:
Your local national Data Protection Authority
(Full list at edpb.europa.eu)

United Kingdom residents:
Information Commissioner's Office (ICO)
Website: ico.org.uk | Phone: 0303 123 1113
privacy.s9Content: Some tech products we sell — such as smartwatches, fitness trackers, and smart home devices — may collect personal data when used. This data is processed directly by the product manufacturer, not by Everything Street. Please review the relevant manufacturer's privacy policy before using any connected device.
privacy.s10Content: Our website and services are not directed to persons under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors. If you believe we hold data about a person under 18, contact us at legal@everythingstreet.ge and we will delete it promptly.
privacy.s11Content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we make material changes, we will update the 'Last updated' date and notify registered customers by email at least 14 days before the changes take effect.
privacy.s12Content:
For any privacy-related questions or to exercise your rights:

Email: legal@everythingstreet.ge
Phone: +995 500 09 06 14
Address: Everything Street, Shalva Nutsubidze St, Tbilisi, Georgia

We aim to respond to all privacy enquiries within 5 business days.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.intro: This Cookie Policy explains what cookies we use on everythingstreet.ge, why we use them, and how you can control them. We use fewer cookies than most e-commerce sites.
cookiePolicy.s1Content:
Cookies are small text files placed on your device by a website. They allow the site to remember information about your visit — such as your language preference, login status, and cart contents.

We use cookies for three purposes: to make our website work correctly (strictly necessary), to understand how visitors use our site (analytics), and to process payments securely (Stripe). We do not use advertising or marketing tracking cookies.
cookiePolicy.s2Content:
These cookies are essential for the website to function. They cannot be declined.

• Authentication session cookie — keeps you logged in. Set by NextAuth. Expires: 30 days or when you close your browser.

• CSRF protection cookie — protects form submissions. Session-scoped.

• Language preference cookie (luxe-locale) — stores your selected language. Expires: 1 year.

• Stripe fraud prevention cookies — required to process payments securely. Cannot be disabled without disabling payments.
  Details: stripe.com/cookie-settings
cookiePolicy.s3Content:
These cookies help us understand how visitors use our website. All data is anonymised. Analytics cookies are only set after you provide consent.

• Google Analytics 4 (_ga, _ga_*)
  Purpose: Tracks pages visited, session duration, and navigation patterns.
  Expiry: 2 years (14-month data retention)
  Set by: Google LLC
  Data location: United States (protected by Standard Contractual Clauses)
  Opt-out: tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout

You can withdraw analytics consent at any time by clearing your cookies.
cookiePolicy.s4Content:
We do not use any marketing, advertising, or social media tracking cookies on this website.

No Meta (Facebook) Pixel, TikTok Pixel, Google Ads remarketing tags, or similar third-party advertising trackers are installed on everythingstreet.ge.
cookiePolicy.s5Content:
You have several ways to control cookies:

• Cookie banner: When you first visit, our cookie banner lets you accept or decline analytics cookies.

• Browser settings:
  – Google Chrome: Settings → Privacy and Security → Cookies
  – Mozilla Firefox: Settings → Privacy & Security → Cookies
  – Safari: Settings → Privacy → Manage Website Data
  – Microsoft Edge: Settings → Cookies and site permissions

Blocking strictly necessary cookies will prevent core site functions from working.
cookiePolicy.s6Content:
The following third parties may set cookies through our website:

• Stripe Payments Europe Ltd
  Purpose: Secure payment processing and fraud prevention
  Cookie management: stripe.com/cookie-settings
  Privacy policy: stripe.com/privacy

• Google LLC (Google Analytics 4)
  Purpose: Anonymised website analytics (consent required)
  Opt-out tool: tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout
  Privacy policy: policies.google.com/privacy
cookiePolicy.s7Content:
We will update this Cookie Policy when we add or remove services that use cookies. For material changes we will notify you via our cookie banner on your next visit.

For questions about our use of cookies, contact us at legal@everythingstreet.ge.
